policy.default_selection: profile=None is full audit; named profiles select exactly their tests after validating the complete manifest schema
policy.non_exempt: forbidden_execution, shell_execution, inline_command, powershell_complex, powershell_unresolved and parse_error cannot be approved. An exception with any forbidden kind rejects the manifest globally, even outside inventory. Only the dedicated fixed_python_bootstrap shape can be reviewed for Python -c; compilation and dynamic imports require exact callsite review, never automatic approval.
policy.hash_contract: Lowercase SHA256 of complete raw file bytes, not generated source; null is pending, never approval. Source is exact AST call segment, or exact PowerShell line. Scope is dotted Python class/function nesting; PowerShell uses <file>.
policy.integration: Run gate before importing any test. Any diagnostic blocks all selection. Do not use unittest discovery to override returned paths. Imports/dependencies and selected files must remain unchanged between review, gate and runner.
policy.limitations: Initial inventory deliberately incomplete. Dependency closure is explicit, not an automated import graph. Python basic aliases only; unknown wrappers, monkeypatches and interprocedural flow still need human review. PowerShell is coarse positive command identification, not a parser: ordinary structure/interpolation and simple variable call targets require exact line review; constructed targets and unparsed quoting/subexpressions are non-exempt. Optional CJS is manual whole-source review. Frontend exceptions are pending handoff records, not scanner coverage.
policy.roles: test is runnable only for pure_mock/process classes; dependency/data/bootstrap use class support and are never selected. Dependencies are scanned and raw-byte hash-bound. Data is hash-bound only and cannot use a recognized source extension.
policy.bootstrap_trust_boundary: Only scripts/check_test_safety.py and scripts/run_safe_tests.py may use role bootstrap, review_kind bootstrap. They require separately reviewed full-file SHA256 and purpose, and are NOT scanned recursively or proven safe by this checker. The parent must review/import its bootstrap independently and bind manifest plus all closure bytes across gate/run; lstat checks are not atomic against concurrent mutation.
policy.runner_interface: check_repository(root, profile=None, process_tests=False, include_maintenance=False) returns (diagnostics, selected_test_paths), empty selection on any diagnostic. resolve_profile(manifest, name) is pure global schema validation returning copied tests/dependencies/test_ids lists; load_execution_profile(root, name) reads the validated manifest and returns the same metadata, NOT execution approval. Gate first, then bind the same snapshot; test_ids absent means all tests in the explicit files, present means exact module.Class.test_method IDs statically present in those modules. No discovery fallback.
policy.pending_review: The six safety-core source files and 31 exact callsite exceptions are source-reviewed and raw-byte hash-bound for that profile only; source review does not establish an executed result. Remaining inventory reviews are pending. Shared bootstrap hashes do not approve pii-core. No global inventory or process-test qualification is supplied. installer-success is intentionally absent until separately qualified.
